I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the West yard Door 2 double-booking is ticket #8841.

That comes from #central-random, which Pree is in. On Oct 13 at 9:27, Tobias Rendle posted that Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Tobias has owned Marrow Fieldworks since January, so I suggested she ask him for any newer status before the customer call.

A note from April's renewal call mentions a "#PD-8841 maybe?" for a separate kiosk high-contrast question. It's unconfirmed, and it's not why I gave #8841; Tobias's message is.
